CORRECTION to the handoff entry above — three names were lost to shell backtick substitution when it was written. Restoring them verbatim:

1. The MCP serving-path alarm applied to production is named:
       rebar-mcp-serving-path-down
   metric mcp_healthy, Statistic Minimum, threshold 1.0 LessThanThreshold, period 300, EP 3, DTA 2, treat_missing_data breaching. State OK. Healthy is defined as HTTP 401 exactly (auth challenge) — a 200 means the auth middleware is not running and is itself worth paging for.

2. The /var/gerrit debris alarm applied to production is named:
       rebar-gerrit-data-disk-debris
   metric data_disk_debris_bytes, dimensions InstanceId + mount=/var/gerrit, threshold 1073741824 (1 GiB), EP 3, DTA 2, treat_missing_data breaching. State OK, publishing 0.0 every 5 minutes.

3. The documented way to re-trigger a Gerrit LLM review WITHOUT pushing a new patch set is to comment:
       rerun-llm-review
   on the change (CONTRIBUTING.md section 2). This matters because `git commit --amend --no-edit` produces a NO_CODE_CHANGE patch set whose copy condition CARRIES A -1 FORWARD rather than re-reviewing. Earlier in this session I worked around that by manufacturing a real content edit; that was unnecessary and is the wrong habit.
